purpose: English Mage image-to-image Edit prompts for the existing MOB checklist; no image generation or game adoption.

source.contextVerification: Current compiled QSP static path/selector audit. Not a manual playtest and not a background image replacement.
source.note: Only source appearance metadata is used. This prompt draft does not assert that its context QSP hash is the current WORK QSP hash.

workflow.input: Current standing image or transparent reference
workflow.output: Active combat pose integrated with the environment
workflow.instruction: Keep identity and actual equipment, replace a static display pose with an active combat stance; do not redescribe appearance.

workflow.input: Existing defeat image when available; otherwise approved stage-1 image
workflow.output: Varied defeated pose with visible battle wear and injuries
workflow.instruction: Keep an existing defeated pose and add injury, blood, exhaustion, and mood. Create a varied new pose only when no defeat image exists.

fog_woodland.label: 안개경계 숲 바닥
fog_woodland.prompt: a mist-covered woodland clearing with damp leaf litter, exposed roots, mossy stones, and layered tree trunks receding into dense pale fog; cold diffused daylight and low drifting ground mist
fog_woodland.grounding: Set the contact points into the leaf litter, compress the wet ground beneath the subject, and add soft contact shadows, subtle reflected green-grey light, and a few foreground leaves overlapping the lowest edges.

sunlit_arena.label: 관중이 있는 햇빛 아래 콜로세움
sunlit_arena.prompt: a sunlit colosseum fighting floor with worn golden sand, scuffed footprints, curved stone arena walls, and crowded spectator tiers softened by distance; strong directional daylight and airborne dust
sunlit_arena.grounding: Set the contact points into the sand with shallow depressions, kicked sand, a single consistent cast shadow, dense contact shadows, and warm reflected light from the ground.

underground_catfight.label: 횃불이 켜진 지하 캣파이트장
underground_catfight.prompt: an underground fighting club with a worn sandy stone floor, rough vaulted masonry, timber railings, and indistinct spectators beyond the ring; warm flickering torchlight balanced with cool ambient shadow
underground_catfight.grounding: Integrate the subject into the worn floor with scuffed grit, grounded contact shadows, warm torch reflections, and coherent light falloff across the entire image.

private_fight_club.label: 개인 결투용 실내 파이트클럽
private_fight_club.prompt: a private indoor fighting room with a broad worn floor, dark timber and rough stone architecture, an open central fighting area, and dim lamps around the perimeter; intimate warm amber light with deep atmospheric background shadows
private_fight_club.grounding: Match the floor perspective beneath the subject, add compressed dust and firm contact shadows, and carry the room light and reflected floor color across the subject and equipment.

burning_ruins.label: 불타는 폐허
burning_ruins.prompt: a battle-scarred ruined courtyard with broken stone paving, scattered masonry, scorched walls, distant flames, rising smoke, and drifting embers; orange firelight mixed with cool smoke-filtered daylight
burning_ruins.grounding: Place the contact points naturally on the uneven paving, with grit around them, dense contact shadows, orange reflected firelight, and smoke softening the distant architecture.

winter_interior.label: 겨울 실내 이벤트
winter_interior.prompt: a rustic winter interior with worn timber flooring, heavy wooden beams, restrained seasonal decorations, frosted windows, and snow visible outside; cold window light mixed with warm candle and hearth light
winter_interior.grounding: Match the floorboard perspective, add grounded contact shadows and subtle dust displacement, and balance the same cool window light and warm interior reflections throughout the image.

portal_wasteland.label: 포털 앞 황무지
portal_wasteland.prompt: a desolate rocky wasteland with fractured dry earth, scattered ancient stone fragments, a monumental portal in the distance, and a barren horizon fading into supernatural haze; cold otherworldly light and sparse drifting dust
portal_wasteland.grounding: Set the contact points firmly on the fractured ground, add displaced dust, deep contact shadows, and subtle reflected portal light consistent with the distance and angle of the portal.

mageEdit.label: 1단계 · 교전 동작·배경 통합 · 안개경계 숲 바닥
mageEdit.prompt: Use the uploaded image as the sole subject-design reference. Preserve the subject identity, proportions, and the design and number of existing weapons and equipment; do not invent extra equipment. Replace the static pose with a compact club-fighting guard: step into range, bend both knees and draw the existing club across the shoulder ready for a heavy swing, with visible weight transfer toward the opponent. Only the target combatant is visible in the foreground. The opponent remains entirely outside the image; do not add a cropped opposing body, shoulder, limb, hand, or weapon in the foreground. Distant indistinct spectators belong to the background only. Rebuild the surrounding image as a mist-covered woodland clearing with damp leaf litter, exposed roots, mossy stones, and layered tree trunks receding into dense pale fog; cold diffused daylight and low drifting ground mist. Use a believable scale derived from the reference and enough foreground floor to make weight, distance, and perspective readable. Set the contact points into the leaf litter, compress the wet ground beneath the subject, and add soft contact shadows, subtle reflected green-grey light, and a few foreground leaves overlapping the lowest edges. Render subject and environment as one coherent painterly dark fantasy game illustration, with unified perspective, light direction, color grading, brushwork, edge treatment, atmospheric depth, and scene contrast; neither photographic nor deliberately pixelated. Compose a complete opaque 795 x 596 landscape scene.

mageEdit.label: 2단계 · 기존 패배 자세·부상 보강 · 안개경계 숲 바닥

Injuries must follow the pose and material; no exposed organs or open internal anatomy. Render subject and environment as one coherent painterly dark fantasy game illustration, with unified perspective, light direction, color grading, brushwork, edge treatment, atmospheric depth, and scene contrast; neither photographic nor deliberately pixelated.
